question: How do I book a trip with Rarecation?
answer:
1. Visit rarecation.com
  2. Browse our Catalog and select your preferred adventure trip
  3. Click the "WhatsApp Us" button at the bottom of the page
  4. Choose one of our travel consultants to assist with your registration
  5. Our consultant will explain the trip concept and itinerary in detail
  6. Once you're satisfied, we'll issue an invoice for your booking
  7. Make payment directly to: RARECATION TRAVEL SDN BHD (Maybank 5622 6352 9023)
  8. Send us the payment receipt to confirm your registration

Note: Travellers from Singapore and Brunei are welcome! Just inform our consultant if you'll be joining from Singapore or Brunei.

question: Why is the trip duration listed as "10 Days 7 Nights"?
answer: The total duration includes 2 travel days (flight time to and from the destination), regardless of overnight stays. So a "10 Days 7 Nights" trip means you'll spend 7 full nights at the destination, with 2 additional days allocated for international flights.

question: Can I extend my trip (arrive early or depart late)?
answer:
Yes, early arrival or late departure extensions are allowed. However:

  • Rarecation is not responsible for any risks faced during your extended stay
  • All additional costs (accommodation, transport, meals) are borne by you
  • We can also help arrange early/late transfers for an additional fee

Please contact our consultant to discuss extension options.

question: What's included in the package?
answer:
Our packages typically include:

  • ✈️ Return flights from KLIA / Changi Airport to destination
  • 🏨 Accommodation throughout the trip duration
  • 🚐 Transportation as per planned itinerary (including tolls, fuel, parking fees if travelling by car/motorhome)
  • 🛡️ Travel insurance (for full-package participants departing from Malaysia)
  • 👕 Limited edition merchandise (Hoodies/Windbreaker from Rarecation)
  • 📋 Pre-trip briefing session (please confirm timing with our consultant)
  • 🍽️ Meals: Half Board / Full Board depending on destination (check specific trip details)

question: What's NOT included in the package?
answer:
The following are excluded from our package price:

  • 📋 Visa fees (where applicable)
  • 🍽️ Some meals (typically self-cooked meals, average budget around RM350 depending on trip)
  • 🚢 Unplanned transportation dependent on weather (ferries, boats, bicycles, cable cars, trains, etc.)
  • 🎯 Optional paid activities dependent on weather (boat rentals, hot spring visits, cycling tours, etc.)
  • 🎫 Paid attractions/entrance fees not in base itinerary

question: What about visa requirements?
answer:
Visa requirements vary by destination and nationality:

  • Some trips require visas, others are visa-free for Malaysian/Singaporean passport holders
  • Visa fees are NOT included in the package price (costs vary by participant nationality)
  • We can assist with visa processing according to our scheduled timeline
  • Please check with our consultant about specific visa requirements for your destination

Tip: Malaysian and Singaporean passports often enjoy visa-free entry to many countries. Always verify current requirements before booking.

question: How does meal arrangement work?
answer:
Nearly all our packages follow a Half Board meal plan:

  • Breakfast ✅ Included
  • Dinner ✅ Included
  • Lunch ❌ Not included (unless stated as Full Board)

Please check each individual trip listing for precise meal plan details, as some destinations may offer Full Board.

question: How much should I budget for meals?
answer:
We recommend budgeting approximately RM300 - RM350 per person for the entire trip for meals not included in the package.

This estimate covers:

  • Lunches (if on Half Board plan)
  • Snacks and drinks between meals
  • Occasional self-cooked group meals (campcook style)

Note: Actual spending may vary depending on destination and personal preferences. Budget-conscious travellers can manage with less, while food enthusiasts may spend more.

question: How much should I budget for personal expenses?
answer:
For personal spending money (souvenirs, shopping, optional activities), we recommend preparing around RM500 or more.

This covers:

  • 🛍️ Souvenirs and local products
  • ☕ Coffee, snacks, personal items
  • 🎁 Gifts for family/friends
  • 🛒 Personal shopping

Budget varies significantly by destination - European trips and Japan typically require more than Southeast Asian destinations. Adjust according to your shopping habits!

question: Is there special pricing for senior citizens?
answer:
We apologize, but there is currently no special senior citizen discount. All adult participants (12 years and above) pay the standard package rate.

However, seniors are most welcome to join our adventures! Please inform our consultant if you have any mobility concerns or special requirements so we can advise on trip suitability.

question: What package is suitable for my 2-year-old child?
answer:
For children aged 2 years and above, pricing follows our Child Package (ages 2-11 years).

Important notes:

  • Package rate is based on child's age on the trip departure date
  • Children under 2 years may be eligible for infant pricing (please check specific trip)
  • Child packages may have different inclusions (e.g., no separate bed)

Contact our consultant for exact pricing and arrangements for young travellers.

question: Can I book a Ground-only package (without flights)?
answer:
Yes, absolutely! We offer ground-only packages for travellers who prefer to arrange their own flights.

Important considerations for ground-only bookings:

  • ❌ Travel insurance is NOT included (we strongly recommend arranging your own)
  • Our consultant can provide travel advice on flight timings to coordinate with group pickup
  • You'll need to make your own way to the meeting point at the destination

Please discuss with our consultant to ensure smooth coordination with the main group.

question: I'm not from Kuala Lumpur. What about transport costs to KLIA?
answer:
Unfortunately, transportation from your location to KLIA/KLIA2 (or Changi Airport) is NOT included in our package price.

You'll need to arrange:

  • Transport to/from your home → KLIA or Changi Airport
  • Parking fees (if driving yourself to airport)

Tips for cost-saving:

  • Bus services (AeroBus, StarMart) from various Malaysian cities to KLIA
  • Carpool with fellow participants (we can help connect you)

question: I'm from Singapore/Brunei. Can I join your trips?
answer:
Absolutely yes! 🇸🇬🇧🇳 We welcome travellers from Singapore and Brunei!

question: I already have travel insurance. Can I get a discount?
answer:
No, we cannot provide a discount if you opt out of our travel insurance.

Here's how it works:

  • Insurance is included in the package price for all full-package bookings
  • Exception: Ground-only packages do NOT include insurance
  • You may choose to use our provided insurance or arrange your own (but no discount applies)

We strongly recommend maintaining valid travel insurance for all international trips.

question: Can I room with my spouse/partner throughout the trip?
answer:
We understand couples want to stay together! Here's our rooming policy:

  • ✅ We prioritize couples and families for room sharing requests
  • Room allocation depends on availability at accommodation venues
  • Please inform our consultant early if you require same-room arrangement
  • We'll do our best to accommodate, but cannot guarantee in all cases (especially for triple/quad sharing situations)

For certainty, please confirm rooming preferences during booking.

question: How much deposit is required to book?
answer:
A deposit of 50% of the total package price is required to secure your booking.

⚠️ Important Policy: Deposits are non-refundable if cancellation is initiated by the participant.

The remaining balance will be due 60 days before departure (see payment terms below).

question: Can I pay in installments?
answer:
Yes! We offer flexible payment options:

Option 1: Full Payment 💯

Pay 100% upfront - Recommended to lock in flight prices early!

Option 2: Installment Plan 📅

  • Step 1: Pay 50% deposit upon booking
  • Step 2: Settle remaining 50% balance 60 days before departure date

Why pay early? Flight prices tend to increase closer to departure dates. Early payment helps us secure better fares for you!

question: What if I need to cancel due to emergency? Can I get my deposit back?
answer:
We understand emergencies happen, but our cancellation policy is as follows:

Cancellation Policy:
If you cancel your participation, the deposit is non-refundable.

This policy exists because we commit payments to airlines, accommodations, and service providers upon your booking confirmation.

In case of genuine emergencies:

  • Contact us immediately - we may be able to discuss options on a case-by-case basis
  • Travel insurance claims may cover cancellation costs (if you purchased comprehensive coverage)
  • Name transfers may be possible (subject to conditions and fees)

We strongly recommend purchasing comprehensive travel insurance that includes trip cancellation coverage.

question: How do I book a cruise with AROYA?

question: What currency is used onboard? Can I use RM/SGD?

question: What about tipping/gratuities on the cruise?

question: What happens in case of bad weather or rough seas?
answer:
Safety is AROYA's top priority ⚓

Weather Contingency Protocols:

Before Departure:

  • Constant monitoring of weather systems
  • Itinerary adjustments made if severe weather predicted
  • Guest notification of any changes via app/email

During Cruise:

  • Captain may alter route/timing to avoid storms
  • Port skips or substitutions possible (safety over schedule)
  • Outdoor activities cancelled/postponed (shows move indoors)
  • Stabilizers activated to reduce rocking motion

If Your Port Call Is Cancelled:

  • ❌ Generally no compensation or refund for missed ports (weather is force majeure)
  • ✅ Alternative onboard activities arranged
  • ✅ Captain keeps guests informed via PA announcements

Motion Sickness Prevention:

  • Choose mid-ship, lower deck cabins (less movement)
  • Pack motion sickness medication (take before symptoms start)
  • Eat light, bland meals (avoid heavy/spicy foods)
  • Stay hydrated but avoid excessive liquids
  • Fix eyes on horizon if feeling queasy
  • Visit medical center if medication doesn't help (injections available)

Good news: The Red Sea and Arabian Gulf are generally calm waters! Rough seas are uncommon except during specific seasons. Your comfort is important to us.
